defense_news.title: Trump swaps planes via catering truck after Iranian threats, reports say
defense_news.summary: Trump was transferred from Air Force One to a military plane via a catering truck due to Iranian threats following a NATO summit in Turkey, reports say.

defense_news.title: Boeing unveils cheap radar seeker built from off-the-shelf parts
defense_news.summary: Seekers are among the most expensive parts of a guided weapon, and Boeing’s argument is that their cost is what limits how many the military can buy.

defense_news.title: Colby pushes back on dwindling stockpile reports amid Southeast Asia tour
defense_news.summary: A senior Pentagon official pushed back against reports that the U.S. military’s stockpiles and capabilities are strained following Operation Epic Fury.

defense_news.title: Pentagon gives industry 21 days to submit plans for ‘significantly faster’ weapons production
defense_news.summary: In a recent memo, the Pentagon pushed defense companies to accelerate production and delivery of critical weapons.
